evidence.scope: One-dimensional fixed-geometry enthalpy diagnostic and scenario mass-energy balances; no grain manufacture or ski validation.

thermal.note: Root is a lumped cylinder; fine branches are identical axial finite volumes. Perfect conducting attachment. No flow, shape change, retraction, capillary breakup, shielding or temperature-dependent viscosity. Stop at root melting onset. Shape-clock is a diagnostic after complete local melting, not a shape prediction.

factory.note: Slurry 0.5% and cake ~50% from EP0597658A1 example. 70/90% cakes, water endpoint, yields and recovery are hypothetical. Water drying added as a sensitivity, not a complete plant quotation. Gas 4.5 m3/kg is a claimed tunnel boundary, not a measured demand or standard m3.
